remarks: This charming townhome at 439 Glenbrook provides the perfect blend of single-family living with the conveniences of a condo. Located in a rare, pet-friendly, 5-unit complex, it features a homeowner-run HOA with low monthly cost. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening on your private front porch. The welcoming entrance leads to a living room with a fireplace, a powder room, and an eat-in kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The formal dining room with bay windows is perfect for entertaining. The spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a bathroom with a jacuzzi. A second bedroom, a full bathroom, and a closet with a stackable washer/dryer complete the upper level. The unfinished basement has ample storage space. Conveniently located within walking distance to the Metro train station, restaurants, and schools, this home also boasts recently refinished hardwood floors as of August 2023.
